rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken intensifier before adjectives and many verb phrases when “hugely” means to a very great extent.

example.english: Things in this shop are hugely expensive.
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 di1 je5 hou2 gwai3

rows.note: Use this especially when “hugely” describes a substantial increase, effect, or change rather than simply a high degree of an adjective.

example.english: Sales increased hugely after we changed the design.
example.traditional: 改咗個設計之後，銷量大大咁增加咗。
example.jyutping: goi2 zo2 go3 cit3 gai3 zi1 hau6 siu1 loeng6 daai6 daai6 gam3 zang1 gaa1 zo2
